description: List the grokbot.tools wishlist: apps people want connected to Grok Bot, sorted by on-site votes or by newest. Each item has its status (requested, claimed, live), on-site vote count, the labeled seed signal ('X buzz (seed)', mentions elsewhere that are never counted as votes), a linked connector if one exists, and its page URL. Votes are only votes made on grokbot.tools and start at 0. Read-only.

limit.description: Max results, 1-25 (default 10). Larger values are clamped to 25.

sort.description: 'votes' = most on-site votes first, then seed buzz (default). 'recent' = newest first.

status.description: Only requests in this state. 'live' means a connector exists. Omit for all.

name: list_requests
title: List the connector wishlist
